snippet.title: ARGOS Alpha Testing - Prehistoric VR Survival, Pre-release October 2026 #argosvr #metaquest #gtag
snippet.description:
Argos is a VR survival game for Meta Quest where you climb and swing with your own arms. No sticks, no teleport.

Wash up on a prehistoric shore with nothing. Punch trees, smash rocks into tools, light real fires, hunt, cook, and build a hut that's still standing tomorrow — alongside other players in one shared world.

What you do:
🪓 Chop  ⛏️ Mine  🔥 Catch fire  🔨 Craft  🎣 Fish  🏠 Build  🏹 Fight  🏊 Swim  💀 Die  👥 Do it together

Stone to bronze to iron. No guns, no menus, no ending.

This is the first Argos trailer — everything in it is shot in the headset, nothing staged. Alpha arrives October 2026, no exact date yet.

▶ Wishlist on Meta: https://www.meta.com/experiences/argos-alpha-testing/1398601528791914/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/PRhcaxFZWf — playtest waves get announced there first.
🌐 argos-vr.com
